harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created an SSH host certificate authority on node1, signed node1's ed25519 host key with it, and configured sshd to present the certificate via HostCertificate. Verified that a client trusting only the CA public key (via @cert-authority in known_hosts, with no pinned host key) connects successfully under StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, both before and after a full node restart. Restart evidence protocol completed: boot_id changed from 77765c08-9e99-4943-a086-f1fef3b3188e to f7657926-99af-4e30-9167-a62827113bc3, confirming a genuine reboot, with sshd and the CA/cert files verified healthy (identical file hashes) and CA-based SSH trust re-verified afterward.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Alpine Linux 3.23, OpenSSH 10.2p1, sshd running under OpenRC
Captured pre-change baseline: boot_id, host key hashes, sshd status, and confirmed strict host-key checking fails without pinning
Generated an ed25519 SSH host CA keypair at /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_host_ca(.pub) on node1
Signed node1's ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub as a host certificate (principals node1 and its NODE_IP, 10y validity) producing /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/host-ca.conf with HostCertificate pointing at the signed cert; validated with sshd -t and sshd -T
Restarted sshd to load the certificate and confirmed it is listening on port 22

Verified certificate-based trust: known_hosts with only an @cert-authority line for the CA public key allowed a StrictHostKeyChecking=yes SSH connection to succeed, with debug output confirming the server presented the certificate and client matched it

Executed mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and file hashes, issued a backgrounded reboot so acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until exec access returned, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified sshd health, CA/cert file integrity, and CA-based SSH trust post-restart

evidence.requirement: SSH host CA created on node1
evidence.summary: ssh-keygen generated /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_host_ca and ssh_host_ca.pub

evidence.requirement: Host key signed by the CA
evidence.summary: ssh-keygen -s signed ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub producing a valid host certificate with principals node1 and NODE_IP; ssh-keygen -L confirms cert details and signing CA fingerprint

evidence.requirement: sshd configured to present the certificate
evidence.summary: Added HostCertificate directive via drop-in, validated with sshd -t/-T (hostcertificate resolved), then cleanly restarted sshd

evidence.requirement: Baseline: host-key pinning normally required (contrast case)
evidence.summary: SSH with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes and empty known_hosts failed with 'Host key verification failed' before CA trust was set up

evidence.requirement: Client trusts host via CA without pinning host key
evidence.summary: SSH with only an @cert-authority line (CA pubkey) in known_hosts succeeded (EXIT=0); debug output shows 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate'

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot id, services, data)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 77765c08-9e99-4943-a086-f1fef3b3188e, sshd started, and sha256 hashes of CA key, CA pubkey, and host cert file

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command scheduled and acknowledgement ('reboot scheduled') returned successfully before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node actually went down and came back
evidence.summary: Polling attempts during reboot returned connection reset/timeout errors, proving the node was unreachable mid-restart

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves genuine restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to f7657926-99af-4e30-9167-a62827113bc3, differing from the pre-restart value, confirming an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of services and data
evidence.summary: sshd status started, sshd -T confirms hostcertificate still configured, and sha256 hashes of CA key/pubkey/cert files are identical to pre-restart, proving data survived

evidence.requirement: Post-restart re-verification of CA-based trust
evidence.summary: Repeated the CA-only known_hosts SSH connection after restart; succeeded (EXIT=0) with identical certificate/CA fingerprints, confirming the certificate-based trust mechanism survived the restart
